Victoria Sterling
Senior Human Resources Business Partner (HRBP)
Dallas, TX | victoria.sterling@hrmail.com | +1 214-555-0168 | linkedin.com/in/victoriasterling-hr

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Strategic Senior HR Business Partner with 8+ years of experience aligning human capital strategies with executive business objectives in high-growth technology and financial organizations. Expert in organizational design, talent management, employee relations, succession planning, compensation structuring, and performance management. Proven track record of reducing employee turnover from 21% to 11% and driving an 88% positive employee engagement score across 850 employees.

WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior HR Business Partner | Summit Financial Technologies | Dallas, TX | 2021 - Present
- Acted as strategic HRBP for Engineering and Product organizations supporting 850 employees and 45 people managers across 4 locations.
- Designed and executed enterprise talent retention strategy, reducing annualized voluntary turnover from 21% to 11% and saving $2.4M in recruitment costs.
- Spearheaded semi-annual performance review cycles and calibrated compensation adjustments using Workday HRIS and market benchmarking data (Radford).
- Managed complex employee relations investigations, ensuring full compliance with federal and state employment laws (FLSA, EEOC, ADA, FMLA).
- Led organizational design and team restructuring during corporate merger, integrating 200+ employees with zero business disruption.

HR Business Partner | InnovateCorp Solutions | Fort Worth, TX | 2017 - 2021
- Partnered with senior leadership to design career development frameworks, competency matrices, and succession plans for 400 staff members.
- Implemented company-wide Employee Engagement Survey via Culture Amp, increasing employee participation to 92% and improving overall satisfaction by 18 points.
- Facilitated leadership development workshops on performance coaching, psychological safety, and constructive feedback for 60+ managers.
- Overhauled onboarding experience, boosting 90-day new hire satisfaction to 96% and decreasing time-to-productivity by 30%.

EDUCATION
Bachelor of Business Administration in Human Resource Management | Texas A&M University | 2013 - 2017

TECHNICAL SKILLS
- HR Strategy & Core: Organizational Design, Talent Management, Employee Relations, Succession Planning, Compensation & Benefits, DEI Strategy
- HRIS & Tools: Workday, Culture Amp, Lattice, BambooHR, ADP Workforce Now, Greenhouse, LinkedIn Talent Insights
- Compliance & Law: EEOC, FLSA, FMLA, ADA, Title VII, Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs), Conflict Resolution
- Analytics & Reporting: HR Analytics, Turnover Analysis, eNPS, Compensation Benchmarking (Radford/Mercer), Workforce Planning

CERTIFICATIONS
- Senior Professional in Human Resources (SPHR) - HRCI (2022)
- SHRM Senior Certified Professional (SHRM-SCP) (2021)
jobDescriptionText:
Seeking a Senior HR Business Partner to support our business units. Requirements:
- 6+ years experience as an HRBP in technology or corporate environments.
- Expertise in organizational design, employee relations, talent management, and HRIS (Workday/Lattice).
- Deep knowledge of employment law and compensation benchmarking.
- SPHR or SHRM-SCP certification preferred.
